SELECT c.cno, c.title, r.cr_content, TO_CHAR(r.cr_created_at,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS cr_created_at, TO_CHAR(r.cr_update_at,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS cr_update_at, (SELECT thumbnail FROM place WHERE pno = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.pnos,1,INSTR(c.pnos,',')-1))) AS thumbnail FROM reply r JOIN course c ON r.cno = c.cno

ORDER BY r.id DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY
